item.title: Novartis RLT Centre Construction
item.description:
• Summary: Construction has begun on a new radioligand therapy (RLT) centre for Novartis. The facility will support the company's growing pipeline of targeted radiopharmaceuticals, which are used in oncology for precision cancer treatment, building on the success of drugs like Lutathera and Pluvicto.
  • MoAs: N/A (RLTs combine a targeting ligand with a radioactive isotope to deliver radiation specifically to cancer cells)
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: Engene Cancer Sales Forecast Cut
item.description:
• Summary: Analysts have cut sales forecasts for Engene's cancer therapy after updated clinical data widened the efficacy gap compared to Johnson & Johnson's competing treatment. The revision reflects concerns over the therapy's commercial potential and competitive positioning in the oncology market.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech

item.title: Zai Lab Combo Therapy
item.description:
• Summary: Zai Lab presents its strategy and rationale for developing combination therapies, highlighting preclinical and clinical data supporting the synergistic potential of its pipeline agents in oncology. The article argues for the value of combinatorial approaches in overcoming resistance and improving patient outcomes.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: ApexOnco
